claims.claim: BarTender utilizes integer twips (1/1440 inch = 0.01764 mm) with +/-8.8 um quantization; Label-Forge uses double-precision canonical millimeters (Length struct) for continuous float precision
claims.evidence_source: src/LabelForge.Core/Geometry/Length.cs implementation and mathematical analysis of GDI MulDiv twip conversions
claims.reconciled_notes: Rationale clarified: metric standardization, continuous floating-point transformation without cumulative rounding drift, and clean conversion to any DPI.
